zh.sourceText: 校长在一次说明会上解释，课堂上少了手机提示音和偷偷刷屏，任课老师普遍反映学生注意力明显更集中。校门口，某儿童手机品牌趁机投放广告：『孩子成长的关键期，值得拥有更精彩的数字世界！』与此同时，该校心理辅导室的记录显示，涉及网络欺凌的投诉比去年同期下降了四成。也有学生代表提出，手机里的学习类 App 是查资料的重要工具，一刀切并不合理。综合这些情况，某市实验中学宣布，禁止学生携带智能手机进入校园，新规从下学期开学起执行。

textRefs.conclusion_1: 禁止学生携带智能手机进入校园
textRefs.reason_1: 课堂上少了手机提示音和偷偷刷屏，任课老师普遍反映学生注意力明显更集中
textRefs.reason_2: 该校心理辅导室的记录显示，涉及网络欺凌的投诉比去年同期下降了四成
textRefs.distractor_1: 孩子成长的关键期，值得拥有更精彩的数字世界
textRefs.distractor_2: 手机里的学习类 App 是查资料的重要工具，一刀切并不合理

hints: 这一章先找理由：哪些信息真的增加了某项校园规定的合理性？
两个理由被广告和反对意见隔开，分别来自课堂观察与心理辅导室记录
找到理由后再问：它们共同指向学校最后宣布的哪项规定？
zh.explanation: 两条理由分别是：课堂上少了手机干扰后注意力更集中，以及网络欺凌投诉下降四成；它们共同支撑「禁止学生携带智能手机进入校园」这一结论。「值得拥有数字世界」是手机品牌借题卖货；「App 是查资料工具、一刀切不合理」是学生的反对意见。本关先找理由、后找段末结论：判断依据是句子之间的支撑关系，不是阅读顺序。

en.sourceText: At a briefing, the principal explained that with fewer notification sounds and fewer students secretly scrolling in class, teachers generally report that students are noticeably more focused. Outside the gate, a children's phone brand seized the moment with an ad: 'These crucial growing years deserve a more wonderful digital world!' Meanwhile, school counseling records show that complaints about cyberbullying fell by forty percent compared with the same period last year. Some student representatives argued that educational apps on phones are important research tools, so an outright ban is unreasonable. After weighing these points, the city experimental middle school announced it will ban students from bringing smartphones onto campus, effective next semester.

textRefs.conclusion_1: ban students from bringing smartphones onto campus
textRefs.reason_1: with fewer notification sounds and fewer students secretly scrolling in class, teachers generally report that students are noticeably more focused
textRefs.reason_2: complaints about cyberbullying fell by forty percent compared with the same period last year
textRefs.distractor_1: These crucial growing years deserve a more wonderful digital world
textRefs.distractor_2: educational apps on phones are important research tools, so an outright ban is unreasonable

hints: This chapter starts with reasons: which information actually strengthens the case for a campus rule?
The two reasons are separated by an ad and an objection, and come from classroom observation and counseling records
After finding the reasons, ask which rule announced at the end they jointly support
en.explanation: The two reasons are improved classroom focus with fewer phone distractions and a forty-percent fall in cyberbullying complaints; together they support the conclusion 'ban students from bringing smartphones onto campus'. 'A more wonderful digital world' is a phone ad, while 'educational apps are important tools' is an objection. This level asks for reasons first and puts the conclusion at the end: support relationships, not reading order, determine each role.
